title: Machine-learning mining uncovers hidden MXenes, including 11 new rare-earth MXenes
summary: The journal abstract reports that machine-learning-assisted database mining identified 33 previously synthesized but unrecognized MXene candidates. Guided by that search, the researchers synthesized seven multilayer MXenes and realized 11 previously unexplored rare-earth-based MXenes. Experiments and modeling suggested semiconducting behavior and diverse magnetic states. Review is limited to the abstract and publication/affiliation metadata.
ai_technology: Machine-learning-assisted database mining for MXene candidates

evidence.tested: Seven multilayer MXenes were synthesized and 11 rare-earth MXenes realized; experiments and modeling assess electronic and magnetic behavior.
evidence.unknown: Review limited to the indexed abstract and publication metadata; full-paper methods and additional limitations were not assessed.
